meta.name: exa-search
meta.description: Web toolkit powered by Exa, tuned for scientific and technical content. Use this skill when the user needs to search the web or fetch/extract URL content. Covers: web search (semantic lookups, research, current info — with optional research-paper category and academic domain filtering) and URL extraction (fetching pages, articles, academic PDFs in batch). Use this skill for web-related tasks when the user wants high-quality search or scholarly filtering via category=research paper. Triggers on requests to search, look up, fetch a page, or extract an article.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索学术网页并提取内容
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要搜索学术资料或批量提取网页内容。
copy.tagline_en: Search academic web and extract content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search scholarly sources or batch-extract web content.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以用 Exa 搜索引擎帮你查科学、技术类信息，也能批量提取网页、文章或学术 PDF 的内容。
howto.when: 当你让 Claude 搜索、查找信息，或者要求它读取某个网页/文章/PDF 时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜索最新的量子计算研究论文。
say.note: Claude 会用 Exa 搜索并优先返回学术来源。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can use the Exa search engine to look up scientific and technical content, and can batch-extract content from webpages, articles, or academic PDFs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask Claude to search, look up information, or fetch/read a specific webpage, article, or PDF.

say_en.text: Search for the latest quantum computing research papers.
say_en.note: Claude will use Exa search and prioritize academic sources.

say_en.text: Extract the abstract of this paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.12345
say_en.note: Claude will fetch the content from that URL.
